test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c668098638df96a3fb5f4f57aafea598ff6e3805389ff4da128b15ca80e8ad71.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Shaded Circles are getting shifted in next places and getting replaced with Triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1745e20706860cdd347eccf3cb8455921ee3695b8e8583bf9528ff78b0bbb5b.png] 

Step II: Symbol '+' are getting shifted in next places and getting replaced with Symbol '÷'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f82362d3c77bd61cc61edcb08f60dfaf09ace7ad94f89936c4d125884f45c3a5.png] 

Step III: Alphabet 'K' are getting shifted in next places and getting replaced with Alphabet 'R'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/459518baf29c0925260b8eb00321cf6ecd255cb52f16b02df6e9ee4f205cceb9.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/380d5b52e0a3e4a91cb9a1598bdd5ffc24b424a979b8878bd82e64e703fd880e.png] 

So, 'Option 4' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
